passages.locator: Commercial contracts, collegantia, paragraph on August 1130
passages.note: The 1130 contract described by the author supplied 200 libbre from the sedentary party and 100 from the travelling party, with two years to trade and proportional loss in the described force-majeure case. The medieval document itself was not inspected.
